symbols.name: transform layout
symbols.meaning: The permutation of record addresses that places the selected bits of the participating axes at one common offset.
symbols.quote: The transform layout $\mathcal{L}$ is an explicit [permutation](permutation.md) of record addresses.

symbols.name: participating axis count
symbols.meaning: The number of participating axes of a round, which is the number of chunks that share one offset.
symbols.quote: Here $D$ is the number of participating axes, and $K$ is the number of bits in each chunk; $K$ has other meanings on earlier pages.

symbols.name: chunk width
symbols.meaning: The number of consecutive address bits in each chunk.
symbols.quote: Here $D$ is the number of participating axes, and $K$ is the number of bits in each chunk; $K$ has other meanings on earlier pages.

symbols.name: chunk offset
symbols.meaning: The position of the selected bit within its chunk, counted from the least significant end.
symbols.quote: Here $\upsilon$ is that offset, the position of the selected bit within its chunk, with $0\le\upsilon<K$.

symbols.name: round bit position
symbols.meaning: The position, counted from the least significant end, of the bit on which a round acts.
symbols.quote: A round on the bit at position $\varsigma$, counted from the least significant end, with $(\lg r-1)\bmod K\le\varsigma\le\lg r-2$, selects offset $(\varsigma-((\lg r-1)\bmod K))\bmod K$ within its chunk.

relations.quote: The transform layout is built from [address-field interchange](address-interchange.md) moves of whole chunks, together with single-bit moves.
The transform layout prepares the input for each [simultaneous butterfly layer](simultaneous-butterfly-layer.md) of a transform round.

relations.predicate: is applied within each round of
relations.quote: The transform layout is applied within each round of the [synthetic polynomial transforms](synthetic-transforms.md).
The transform layout is consumed by the [opposite transform](opposite-transform.md).
The transform layout $\mathcal{L}$ is an explicit [permutation](permutation.md) of record addresses.
The transform layout keeps each element of the [polynomial ring](polynomial-ring.md) that a record holds intact.

relations.predicate: is the output order retained by
relations.quote: The transform layout is the output order retained by the [forward procedure](forward-transform.md) for a pointwise product and the following opposite procedure.
The transform layout follows the pattern of the [transform identity with retained permutations](transform-identity.md), keeping its permutation in the computation.

relations.predicate: places the selected bits of every
relations.quote: The transform layout places the selected bits of every [participating axis](transform-axis.md) at one common offset, so one pass can apply a butterfly to all of them.
The transform layout counts its offsets from the [least significant end](address.md) of each address.
